fix(chat): show full session title via styled tooltip on hover

The sidebar session list truncates long titles/subtitles with an
ellipsis, and the only way to read the full text was the browser's
native `title` attribute tooltip (unstyled, delayed), inconsistent
with the Radix tooltip already used for the row avatar.

Wrap the title/subtitle block in the same Tooltip/TooltipContent
used elsewhere in this component so hovering shows the full title
and subtitle. Row height, truncation and list density are unchanged.

Testing:
- tsc -b --noEmit: no errors
- vitest run src/components/AppSidebar.test.tsx: 6 passed
- vite build: succeeds

pull_request.body:
## Summary
The chat sidebar's session list truncates long titles/subtitles with an ellipsis, and the only way to read the full text was the browser's native `title` attribute tooltip (unstyled, delayed) — inconsistent with the styled Radix tooltip already used for the row avatar in the same component.

## Changes
- `ChatSessionRow` (`AppSidebar.tsx`): wrap the title/subtitle block in the same `Tooltip`/`TooltipContent` pattern used for the row avatar, so hovering shows the full title and subtitle in a styled tooltip.
- Remove the now-redundant native `title` attributes.
- Row height, truncation behavior, and list density are unchanged.

## Testing
- `tsc -b --noEmit`: no errors
- `vitest run src/components/AppSidebar.test.tsx`: 6 passed
- `vite build`: succeeds

## Risks
No obvious risks — single-component, presentation-only change; no API or data-model changes.
